name: l0_entity_constructor_defaults
about: The base constructor CBaseEntity::CBaseEntity FUN_1009d980 0x1009d980 (`walks/L0-r016.md`, 33 steps in retail order over a calloc(1, size) allocation -- CBaseEntity::operator new 0x100aa720 -> engine slot 45 0x201092d0). Every one of its 286 call sites passes 0 for the bool, so 0x200 is never set. What it leaves: the handles -1 (m_hUseActivator +0x8c, m_pParent +0x254, m_pMoveParent, m_pMoveChild, m_pMovePeer, m_hOwnerEntity +0x364, m_hAimEnt +0x37c, m_hGroundEntity +0x384, m_RefEHandle +0x448); the CCollisionProperty from FUN_100dc190 then FUN_100dc300(this): mins = maxs = 0, radius 0, m_Solid 0, m_usSolidFlags 0, partition handle 0xffff; m_CollisionGroup 0; m_flElasticity 1.0 (0x3f800000, 1009db3a); m_clrRender 0xFFFFFFFF; m_nSimulationTick -1; m_flLastThink = curtime; m_rgflCoordinateFrame identity; m_iCurrentThinkContext -1; SetSolid(0) and ClearSolidFlags() as no-ops on the zeroed words (FUN_100dc480 exits at 0x100dc486; FUN_100dc580 stores 0 over 0 and exits at 0x100dc599); SetMoveType(0,0), SetOwnerEntity(NULL) no-ops; SetCheckUntouch(false) clears 0x1000000 (0x100b127d); SetModelIndex(0), SetModelName(NULL); SetCollisionBounds(vec3_origin, vec3_origin) at 1009dca4 -> FUN_100dc770 -> FUN_100dda20's |= 0x14000, and FUN_100ddd20 finds the NULL edict (IndexOfEdict(NULL) == 0, engine 0x20109110): no 0x8000, no dirty-list append; ClearFlags() -> m_fFlags 0; m_flFriction 1.0 (1009dcb5); m_iEFlags |= 0x50000 (1009dcdc) -> 0x54000; the self-downcast caches 0; m_iVSoundGroup / m_iVSoundGroupFemale / m_iVSoundTableIdx -2; the hidden / transparent / blocks-traces / occludes-sound bytes 0; m_nWaterLevel 0. Never written: m_flNextThink (0.0), m_vecSize, m_iName, m_ModelName, m_lifeState, m_spawnflags, m_iHealth, m_MoveType, m_flGravity. `fresh` is created at run time (CreateEntityByName: constructor, edict attach, keyvalues), so the constructor's sites are traced; `placed` is a map row whose constructor ran at Load and is read by probes alone -- the two read the same words. Reported as `fail`, a word or a site payload differs from retail's.

notes: The constructor returns m_iEFlags = 0x54000 (bits 14, 16, 18; `ctor_return`); the probed post-spawn word is 376832 = 0x5c000 because the keyvalue pass that follows runs with the edict attached and its `origin` arm (CBaseEntity::KeyValue 0x1009e430 -> SetAbsOrigin 0x100b2300 -> FUN_100b52a0 -> FUN_100ddd20) marks 0x8000 once (`origin_mark`, read with 0x800 still raised by FUN_100b5340 and cleared right after; L0-r017 / r018); no mins/maxs key follows, so `already_dirty` never fires. The words compared through the port's mapping rather than raw (`walks/L0-r016.md` Record notes): the handles are `FElysiumEntityHandle`s, read as `-1` when unset; `m_flNextThink` is not probed because this port's never-think word is the queue's FLT_MAX sentinel where retail's is 0.0 (the `nextthink` row answers the sentinel); `m_flLastThink` is `curtime` at construction, the world clock the trace stamps carry (the `spawn` at scenario 0.10 reads as world 1.1 in the `entity_ctor` payload; `placed`'s is the Load time): probed as written and positive, matched exactly by the trace stamp of its own site. Not carried, so not probed: m_rgflCoordinateFrame (the pose is recomputed from the local words), m_hPlayerSimulationOwner (L3), the two COutputEvents (outputs fire by name), m_aThinkFunctions / m_ResponseContexts / m_DamageModifiers (empty containers with no port object), m_nModelIndex (UNBOUND: models resolve by name), the self-downcast caches (the class chain answers them). `m_iName` is probed by no row: the constructor leaves it 0 and the keyvalue pass that follows writes `fresh`.
